meta.question: Does a decider fine-tuned on the restorer's decision beat Sonnet self-confidence, the base 2B and hosted v19?
meta.rule: Chosen fine-tuned variant: among the candidates, the most top-1 matches on the 280-gap VAL selection set (routed Sonnet -> Opus, ontology on, escalation unchanged at 0.6 on the raw top-1); ties go to fewer decider calls, then the lower p50 latency per gap. Rows where the decider failed and the restorer fell back to self-report count as misses. Only the chosen variant is scored on TEST (once). The deployed default (hybrid-prerank, 100/280) would change only if the chosen variant had strictly more VAL matches AND could be served by the cloud runtime; the runtime cannot serve a local checkpoint, so this run adds the model to config/models.yaml disabled in either case and reports whether it was eligible.
